purpose: Teach: ほうれん草/ワックス/立ち寄る/小さめ/お喋り/ひと言/燃やす/グチ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ほうれん草、絶対、お弁当に、絶対、入れたわよ
lines.en: Sho, I really did put spinach in your lunchbox — I promise, absolutely.
lines.style: Warm, gentle insistence. Slight lift on the repeated promises, like she's making a playful vow. Soft delivery, genuinely reassuring.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの車、絶対、ワックス、絶対、ピカピカだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's car is seriously shining — I waxed it, for real, really shiny!
lines.style: Bright, proud energy. Quick pace, crisp words on each promise. The earnestness of a small boy proving something. Genuine excitement, not showing off.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 帰りに、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さんの、絶対、お店に、絶対、立ち寄る、絶対、わね、翔くん
lines.en: On the way home, you've got to stop by my shop — I mean it, Sho.
lines.style: Tender invitation wrapped in light insistence. Warm opening, slight pause before the name. Drawing him in gently, not commanding. Affectionate firmness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、小さめ、絶対、のお茶碗、絶対、お気に入りだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love that small rice bowl of yours — that's my favorite one.
lines.style: Earnest, straightforward. Each promise lands clearly. Small boy's seriousness about small things he cares about. Quiet conviction, no rush.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、翔くんと、絶対、お喋り、絶対、いつも、絶対、楽しいわ
lines.en: You know, talking with you is always so fun for me — I really mean that, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth. Reflective tone, like she's noticing something true in the moment. Unhurried. The tenderness of someone who enjoys being seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ママに、絶対、ひと言、絶対、お礼、絶対、言ってきたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I already thanked Mom like you said — I really did make sure to tell her.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride. Clear delivery, small boy's earnestness. Each promise is a check mark. Not boasting, just reporting something he did well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お庭の枯葉、絶対、燃やす、絶対、と、絶対、いいわよね、翔くん
lines.en: You know, burning the fallen leaves in the garden is nice — don't you think so, Sho?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly dreamy. Gentle rhythm, lingering on the image. Conversational, inviting his agreement. Quiet warmth, not pushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、グチ、絶対、を、絶対、言わないように、絶対、頑張るよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really going to try not to complain so much — I promise I'll do my best.
lines.style: Sincere, determined but soft-spoken. Each promise carries weight without strain. A small boy making a genuine commitment. Earnest and close.
